name: c2hell
description: C2 HELL — lite-sim de mando y control de defensa aérea (web + Android + iOS con Capacitor)

scripts.native:add:android: cap add android && node tools/patch_native.js android && npm run assets:android
scripts.native:add:ios: cap add ios && node tools/patch_native.js ios && npm run assets:ios
scripts.sync: npm run www && cap sync && node tools/patch_native.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
